text:
Revise the retained proposal while preserving every accepted requirement, its exact public input/output contracts, product order, maximum ten products, actual individual product navigation, actual document_write, writer-derived filePath and browser cleanup. This is an explicit limited structural correction of data adaptation and removal of work not requested by the accepted outcomes; do not change business requirements or invent observations.

1. Correct REQUIREMENTS_OUTPUTS_CHANGED at /outputs/products. The accepted products value is a nonnullable array (minItems 0, maxItems 10) of nonnullable records with REQUIRED name, description, price and error fields, each nullable string. Preserve that exact contract, including the accepted output requiredness. Missing facts remain null, never empty strings, unrelated URLs or fabricated error text. Already typed normalization/copying uses direct bindings, not further learned extraction.
2. Remove detect_cookie_prompt and accept_cookies_if_present (including click_cookie_accept), and remove any observation whose sole purpose was that unrequested interaction. No substitute consent task, filtering or deduplication. Preserve the requested search and product visits. Do not infer a blocking condition from a generic page link or label. Actual producer errors must fail truthfully.
3. Replace whole-operation snapshot extraction with the available bounded complete observationSnapshot.pages collection. Validate the original snapshot's presence/completeness using its real typed metadata before consuming it. Each extract explicitly binds pages and declares each.input = pages; each source page emits one compact array, so its complete resultType is array<array<T>> within the result field named by each.output. Process every complete page; use one-level flatten only for actual arrays of arrays. Preserve full observations separately. Each extraction contract includes only facts needed by its immediate consumer.
4. Candidate selection is a business decision over the compact offered candidate facts, with original opaque identifiers copied verbatim (never shortened). Select only IDs, in source order, with at most ten and no new ranking/filtering/deduplication criterion. Resolve those IDs against offered candidates, then original observed records with existing strict lookup, preserving repetitions. Derive every visited URL from the original record, not a model-generated URL in the selection result. Use existing minimal pure foreach projection only where needed to gather original record arrays; no field access on arrays.
5. Per visited product: acquire complete observation pages, extract compact nullable observed facts independently per page, then assemble/select the product's observed facts from those compact inputs if a genuine global interpretation is needed. Never pass the original snapshots alongside compact facts. Preserve one non-null product record per actual visit. Keep the previously bounded TSV formatting over at most ten compact product records and actual XLSX writing at the accepted destination; do not turn failure or an unusable acquisition into a successful empty workbook.

Use only existing typed bindings, flatten, lookup, foreach, requires, transform modes and discovered operations. requires remains a local mandatory assertion on real typed values; no choice(operation), success-flag substitute, new operator, scripts or contract casts. Preserve all existing host-owned arguments, permissions and budgets. Fully validate producer contracts and public outputs before returning the revised plan.
